body: We used an offline VM running a copy of our Agie Classic Cut 2S machine control. In the loaded 20 mm Berco punch, the work editor displayed the requested Ra target of 0.35 µm. The control plotted the rough cut and three trims. This test verified the selected target and motion. Measuring the resulting surface finish requires a physical cut. See #2999 for the check on repeat import.

Port onto the zero-step setup of #2984, stacked on #2978 (`124be7caf`). New head: `17cb6f617`.

- The merge took the frame side for each conflict. The old script writer (`jescript.rs`) is deleted on the frame, so the quality request moved to `agie_setup`: one quality object `CCB035` on the piece, zero steps, no armed technology.
- CCB035 is limited to one polygon punch on a 20 mm plate. A group, a DXF arc punch, a die, an open cutoff and the other heights are refused before any file is written.
- The existing goldens did not change. The new FINE20 golden differs from CCSEP20 in the `JE_CreateQuality` line only.
- Emulated control: `CCB035[0]` after import. Ra 0.35 / Tkm 1.0 / Te 1.5 shown. TECCUT preselected row 0204 (`estbca25nnn060b030020`, the Ra 0.30 technology, 4 passes). After the assignment: T100, 245/155/140/134 µm, `geen fouten`. The plot matches. The 5-pass Ra 0.35 row 0289 was not preselected and not measured.
- Quick gate: only the known red of #3774. The clippy finding in the new test is fixed and passed again on the final head.

The PR body has the full readings.

This PR goes back to draft for the review fixes and a quality change. The fix moves the new top-level test binaries into existing suites. CCB035 then requests the Ra 0.35 technology that the control measured on 25 Nov. The PR is flagged ready again when the gate is green.

Reply to the review of `17cb6f617` (comment 7125893172). New head: `688f776e0`.

1. **`Process change: yes`** (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:146`): the body has the line. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not changed.

4. **Goldens moved** (`CIRCLE20.ISO:1`): the body lists the eight added files with their reasons.

**Quality change on this head (decided by the user, from the control measurement of 25 Nov).** Commit `655566b1c`:

- `CCB035` now sets the speed option: `JE_CreateQuality(je_piece,"CCB035","0.35,1.50,1.00,T,F,F",je_q1)`. With this flag, the control preselects the Ra 0.35 technology `estbca25nsn060b035020` (TECCUT header `TYPE:VS`). The job still arms no technology.
- `CCB035_OFFSETS_UM` is now 5 passes at 20 mm: 234, 189, 154, 139 and 129 µm. `Quality::offsets_um` returns all passes. The checks use the main cut (234 µm). The 0.4 mm margin does not change. `CCB030` keeps its 4-pass table.
- The review text and the user guide name the technology, `TYPE:VS`, 5 passes and the offsets, and tell the operator to stop if one differs.
- The FINE20 golden changes in one line only:

```diff
-  ok=JE_CreateQuality(je_piece,"CCB035","0.35,1.50,1.00,F,F,F",je_q1)
+  ok=JE_CreateQuality(je_piece,"CCB035","0.35,1.50,1.00,T,F,F",je_q1)
```

  All CCB030 goldens are byte-identical. The FINE20 ISO and SBR do not change.
- Control check of this head (emulated Classic Cut 2S, throwaway clone, base image SHA-256 unchanged): `CCB035[0]` after import, header `TYPE:VS`, preselected `estbca25nsn060b035020`, `CCB035[5]` after Assign with offsets 234/189/154/139/129 µm, FORMALCHECK `geen fouten`. The J00 is byte-identical to the 25 Nov probe. The body has the readings.
- Decision record: `docs/decisions/2966-agie-fine-quality.md`, section "Request the Ra 0.35 technology itself".

Pinning tests: `agie::quality_tests::ccb035_changes_only_the_quality_line_of_a_20_mm_punch` (the new request and review text), `agie::quality_tests::ccb035_has_five_measured_passes_and_keeps_the_0_4_mm_margin` (new), `agie_native` `quality::the_saved_condition_selects_the_exact_requested_quality` (FINE20 golden), and the other `quality::` and `agie::quality_tests` tests.
